caption: The trial on the Starter plan at $97 a month, with Skip Trial & Pay and a note that the card is charged automatically when the 13 days run out. Account name and initials are hidden.

Near the end of the cancel flow a warning lists what you lose, including contacts and workflows, and says the $2.00 wallet credit is forfeited. Cancelling took about nine screens and five retention offers.
The trial comes with five example contacts in CRM Smart Lists, tagged follow up and warm lead. These are HighLevel sample records, not real people.
A workflow we built from scratch: trigger Contact Created, action Add Tag. It stayed a draft and was never published.
Billing after cancelling: No active subscription with agency plan. We had to enter the account password to confirm. Account name, initials and customer ID are hidden.
